correctness.rationale: Tafazolian Proposition 8.2 proves complete geometric group with all generators rational over Fp. Constant Galois action makes arithmetic forms exactly group conjugacy classes. Explicit descent models realize every class; the hyperelliptic twists have squarefree degree-2p polynomials. Point counts include all rational points at 0 and infinity and use elementary character sums. The multiplicity equations are exact. The included finite checker agreed for all p<=37, but the general proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The canonical arithmetic forms of a natural ordinary, large-automorphism genus-p-1 curve are classified completely with explicit models and every possible Fp point-count multiplicity. Each geometric family has a point-free form, a structural consequence not determined by the geometric group order or by a general moduli mass formula alone. The object and invariant are intrinsic, and the family spans all primes p>=5.
